ledgers.semantics: per-surface EWMA of graded signal weights (-1..+1), alpha=0.2 (ops/delphi/panel.json flywheel.ewma_alpha), damped: one EWMA step per batch at the batch mean (gate.py apply_outcomes, issue #1533); idempotency digest sha256(key|outcome)[:16] per surface, newest 2000 kept (gate.py signal_digest/dedupe_signals); tribute ingestion cap 200 records/batch (gate dispatch cap, PR #1824)
ledgers.state_rule: newest marker comment carrying a ```json block is the current state (gate.py latest_json)
ledgers.title: Delphi outcome ledger

ledgers.semantics: per-role gate_pass_rate EWMA (step = alpha*|weight|) + Elo (k=16, panel.json flywheel.elo_k), hits/misses tallies (gate.py feedback_graded)
ledgers.state_rule: newest marker comment carrying a ```json block is the current state (gate.py latest_json)
ledgers.title: Delphi panel weights ledger

derivation.rule: weights are DERIVED from events by this formula — stores carry events + this derivation; snapshots are payloads of record, never the only copy of the math

update.gate_pass_rate: round(0.8*gpr + 0.2*(1 if hit else 0), 4)  [binary feedback, gate.feedback]

ledgers.semantics: append-only; a later signed [MUSEai]@ comment may correct an earlier event (corrections are new events, never edits)
ledgers.state_rule: no folded state; the event stream is the record (ranked outcomes + calibration deltas feeding weights/outcomes)
ledgers.title: Delphi generation ballots + calibrations (appended to the outcome ledger issue)

living_records.semantics: not append-only at the source; the feed + the Neon mirror make versions append-only by keying on the body hash; ASSIGNED MARKER (Delphi lane recommendation, 2026-10-28): future snapshot comments on living-record issues carry '<!-- delphi-living v1 -->' so collectors can separate them from third-party noise; the #2028 body pattern is unchanged until its writer adopts it
living_records.state_rule: the issue BODY is the current state (edited in place by the keepalive job); version key = sha256(body) — a changed hash is a new version of the record
living_records.title: Temporal self-host status (living record)

living_records.semantics: DERIVED board regenerated by delphi-gate into the issue body (generated-at stamp in body); ledger of record = newest '<!-- delphi-ledger v1 -->' comment per RFP issue — the board itself is a render, never a source
living_records.state_rule: the issue BODY is the current board (body starts with the delphi-board marker); version key = sha256(body)
living_records.title: Delphi results board

note: Registry of Delphi continuous ledgers + living records. Consumed by scripts/delphi/ledger_fetch.py + ledger_feed.py (schema delphi-ledger-feed/v1, contract docs/ops/DELPHI-LEDGER-STORE.md). A comment is a ledger event iff its body starts with one of the ledger's markers or with '[MUSEai]@' (signed append, e.g. corrections); anything else on the issue is noise and is counted, never carried.

invariants.append_only: corrections are NEW events naming what they supersede, never edits (one graded step once consumed by a misdirected write was deliberately NOT replayed — bounded-loss lesson)
invariants.idempotency: keys on every ingest: tribute signals keyed by thread URL, gate dedupe sha256(key|outcome); mirror/feed key sha256(ledger_id|comment_id)
invariants.source_classes_rule: never collapsed in any store, feed or render; DRIVER_SYNTHESIS is not a ballot
invariants.honest_negatives: none_validated_yet / none_yet and similar are findings recorded as data, never coerced to null or dropped
invariants.resolution: ledgers resolved by exact issue TITLE at registration (label-order resolution misdirected state to #1567/#1784 once; fixed PR #1833); this registry pins the resolved numbers
